resources.string: Add names and terms you often dictate.
Words stay on this device and are sent with each recording or Retry as recognition hints. Recognition is not guaranteed. Adding or editing a word sends nothing.
Use one line without control characters or < and >.
This word is already in your list.
The dictionary reached its local 64 KiB text limit. Shorten or delete a term before adding more.
This word changed. Check the list and try again.
Could not read or save Words. Check storage and reload; your input is kept.
Stop sends the recording for transcription using gpt-transcribe. API charges may apply. No automatic retries.
Save encrypts your key with Android Keystore; Forget removes it. Recordings and text stay until you delete them. Copy shares only text with the clipboard. Leaving stops the microphone and network.
Recording stopped safely. Processing the full captured audio.
The saved key is unchanged. Save to replace it.
Could not read or update secure key storage. Forget the saved key and enter it again.

Optional special access. Android Accessibility lets this app observe keyboard windows and focused editor metadata across apps, and insert your final dictation. The system grants broader screen-content access; this app does not capture screenshots or read, send, log or save unrelated app text. Recordings you explicitly start and your saved Words are sent to OpenAI as transcription hints and may incur API charges. The bubble never sends messages or presses Enter. Password, numeric/payment and recognized sensitive editors are excluded. Auto-insertion requires Android 13+, a stable caret and a compatible editor; otherwise Copy is offered. No replacement keyboard or separate draw-over-apps permission is required. You can disable this feature here or in Accessibility settings at any time. An API key is needed for transcription. Offline recording is available without one.
Editor or caret changed. Recording cancelled; Copy received text yourself.
Microphone and visible recording notification permissions are required. Open setup, then tap the circle again.
Android blocked the microphone service. Open setup or use in-app dictation. No recording started.
Cancelled. Nothing inserted; received text can be copied.
This editor, selection or Android version cannot be inserted into safely. Nothing inserted. Copy and paste yourself.
Insertion could not be confirmed. Check the field before using Copy; it may already contain the text. No retry or Send was performed.
System clipboard could not accept the text. Nothing was submitted.
Optional Accessibility access shows a movable dictation button beside your keyboard. Read and accept the access explanation before enabling. Recording starts only when you tap the circle.
Tap to stop · Hold for controls

Tap the wave to start or stop. Hold during recording for Cancel. A red wave indicates a failed session; tap to start again. Hold while idle to open setup and recover genuinely unsent text. An unverified insertion settles silently and is never repeated. Recovery stays only in process memory until discarded or the process ends.
Upload failed. Open the app Settings and save a valid API key, then retry. Your recording is still saved.
Upload failed. Check your connection, then retry. Your recording is still saved.
The service could not transcribe this recording. Check your account or try later. Your recording is still saved.
Could not save the recording. Check available device storage. Existing saved data has been kept.
Interrupted · retry only when you choose
Recording needs attention. Its data has been kept.
Delete this recording, its audio and saved text?
Received text could not be saved. Copy it or save it again without another upload.
Your recordings and transcripts will appear here.
Could not play this audio. Your recording has been kept.
Audio was interrupted and may be incomplete.
